parent_edge_schema: for each a in A_r: a-s, a-z
for each b in B_q: b-t, b-m, b-z

symbolic_derivation: Before pair fixing, the frozen post-constructor fixed set is S'={s,t,p,m,n}; X0'=X'=empty; the undecided vertices are {z} union A_r union B_q.
The theorem operation additionally fixes exactly a_i and b_j.

For every a in A_r\{a_i}, the parent no_other_edges schema gives no edge a-a_i and no edge a-b_j; its list therefore receives no deletion from the newly fixed pair and remains [2,3,4], hence is not singleton.
For every b in B_q\{b_j}, there is no edge b-a_i and no edge b-b_j; its list remains [1,3,4], hence is not singleton.

z is adjacent to both a_i and b_j, so its list becomes [1,2,3,4]\{gamma,delta}; because gamma,delta are in {3,4}, this list has size 3 when equal and size 2 when unequal, hence is never singleton or empty.
Thus exact frozen boundary propagation fixes no further vertex.
O1_VERTEX_EXACTNESS.degenerate_case: If r=q=1, both A_r\{a_i} and B_q\{b_j} are empty, so the residual vertex set is exactly {z}.

symbolic_derivation: Project the exact parent edge set onto the residual vertex set from O1.
All five fixed-base edges s-t,s-p,p-m,m-n,t-n have both endpoints removed.
For any remaining a, edge a-s is removed because s is fixed, while edge a-z survives because both a and z are residual.
For a_i, both a_i-s and a_i-z are removed because a_i is fixed.
For any remaining b, edges b-t and b-m are removed because t,m are fixed, while edge b-z survives.
For b_j, b_j-t,b_j-m,b_j-z are removed because b_j is fixed.
The parent explicitly has no other edges, so no additional residual edge exists.
O2_EDGE_EXACTNESS.residual_edges: {z-a : a in A_r\{a_i}} union {z-b : b in B_q\{b_j}}

O3_LIST_EXACTNESS.propagation_rule: For residual v, delete from its exact pre-pair list the colors of newly fixed adjacent pair vertices a_i,b_j and perform no stronger unpublished preprocessing.
O3_LIST_EXACTNESS.exactness_reason: Parent no_other_edges prevents any other pair-induced adjacency/list deletion.

O4_NONEMPTY_LISTS.conclusion: Every residual list is nonempty; no residual list is singleton.

derivation: By O2 every residual edge is incident with z.
Every residual A/B vertex has exactly one residual neighbor z.
Hence for r+q-2>0 the residual graph is K_{1,r+q-2}.
When r=q=1, r+q-2=0 and the residual graph is the isolated single vertex K1.
A star and K1 are acyclic.

O6_T2_BIND.binding: O4 supplies finite nonempty exact lists and O5 supplies a forest. The sealed T2 theorem accepts arbitrary finite lists on forests and reconstructs a coloring in polynomial time.

list_membership_checks.reason: These are exactly the frozen seed/post-constructor fixed colors.
Assigned color 1 is never deleted because gamma,delta are only 3 or 4; thus 1 belongs to [1,2,3,4]\{gamma,delta}.

O7_DIRECT_CONSTRUCTIVE_EXTENSION.conclusion: For every quantified tuple the fixed pair assignment extends to an explicit proper list-respecting coloring of the entire frozen G_{r,q} instance.

D2_semantics.statement: For a fixed survivor pair and assignment (gamma,delta), q_{gamma,delta}=1 exactly when the pair-fixed exact state has a valid extension.

O8_PI_BIT.derivation: O7 constructs such an extension for every r,q,i,j,gamma,delta in the frozen domain; therefore q_{gamma,delta}=1 universally on this family.
O8_PI_BIT.consequence: Pi(a_i,b_j)={33,34,43,44}={3,4}^2 for every (a_i,b_j) in A_r x B_q.

statements: For all r,q>=1, all i in [r], j in [q], and gamma,delta in {3,4}, the exact pair-fixed residual is K_{1,r+q-2}, with K1 when r=q=1.
The exact residual lists are [2,3,4] on remaining A, [1,3,4] on remaining B, and [1,2,3,4]\{gamma,delta} on z.
Every such residual routes through the already sealed T2_FOREST_LIST terminal.
Every fixed assignment extends; hence every survivor pair has Pi={3,4}^2.
theorem_conclusion.complexity_statement: For this frozen parametric G_{r,q} family, pair-fixed residual recognition/construction and T2 solution/reconstruction are polynomial.
theorem_conclusion.semantic_quotient_note: Within this frozen family all survivor pairs have the same Pi mask {3,4}^2, so the family-specific semantic Pi quotient has one class; this does not establish a universal exact pair quotient for arbitrary C11/PI residuals.
